Both are marked active and flagged `[muninn:conflict]` against each other. Per this project's own instructions, a conflict means two active facts disagree and I should ask rather than pick one — I shouldn't silently resolve it by timestamp or invent a value, since the whole point of flagging it is that it needs your call.

Which one actually stands — msgpack or cbor — so I can write `docs/policies/wire-format.md` accurately? Or if neither is truly current, I'll write the doc stating nothing current is recorded.
